2462: static int ACLSaveToFile(const char *filename) {

2464:     int fd = -1;
2465:     sds tmpfilename = NULL;
2466:     int retval = C_ERR;
2467: 
2468:     /* Let's generate an SDS string containing the new version of the
2469:      * ACL file. */
2470:     raxIterator ri;
2471:     raxStart(&ri, Users);
2472:     raxSeek(&ri, "^", NULL, 0);
2473:     while (raxNext(&ri)) {
2474:         user *u = ri.data;
2475:         /* Return information in the configuration file format. */
2476:         sds user = sdsnew("user ");
2477:         user = sdscatsds(user, u->name);
2478:         user = sdscatlen(user, " ", 1);
2479:         robj *descr = ACLDescribeUser(u);
2480:         user = sdscatsds(user, descr->ptr);
2481:         decrRefCount(descr);
2482:         acl = sdscatsds(acl, user);
2483:         acl = sdscatlen(acl, "\n", 1);
2484:         sdsfree(user);
2485:     }
2486:     raxStop(&ri);
2487:

2489:     tmpfilename = sdsnew(filename);
2490:     tmpfilename = sdscatfmt(tmpfilename, ".tmp-%i-%I", (int)getpid(), commandTimeSnapshot());

part.text:
Fixed the replica crash during `ACL LOAD` in `src/acl.c`.

The ACL reload client-remapping loop now skips internal root clients that have no ACL user, including the primary connection maintained by a replica. This avoids dereferencing `c->user` while preserving ACL refresh behavior for authenticated external clients.

Validation completed in the supplied container:

```sh
make -j4
./runtest --single unit/acl
```

All ACL unit tests passed, including `Test ACL LOAD works on replica`.
